"};
 const paintedTextures={};
 const whiteTex=gl.createTexture();gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,whiteTex);gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,gl.RGBA,1,1,0,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,new Uint8Array([255,255,255,255]));
 for(const [type,b64] of Object.entries(EMBEDDED_PAINTED_ATLASES)){
  const tex=gl.createTexture();paintedTextures[type]=tex;
  const img=new Image();img.onload=()=>{
   gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,tex);gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL,true);
   gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,gl.RGBA,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,img);

   gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);

 }
 gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
 
 // Do not keep the encoded data twice once it has been uploaded to the GPU.
 for(const key of Object.keys(GLB_EMBEDDED))delete GLB_EMBEDDED[key];
 const modelStats=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(models).map(([type,parts])=>[type,parts.reduce((n,p)=>n+(Array.isArray(p)?p.reduce((a,m)=>a+(m?.count||0),0):p?.count||0)/3,0)]));
 const totalTriangles=Object.values(modelStats).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
 let debugLast=0,debugFrames=0,debugDrawn=0;
 let showDetail=true,showMaterials=true,visualClock=0;
 const headings=new Map();
 function drawPart(part,heading,pitch=0,pivot=0,recoil=0,motion=0,motionMode=0,forceColor=false){if(!part)return;
  gl.uniform1f(loc.motion,motion);gl.uniform1f(loc.motionMode,motionMode);
  gl.uniform3fv(loc.motionPivot,part.pivot||[0,0,0]);
  gl.uniform1f(loc.heading,heading);gl.uniform1f(loc.pitch,pitch);gl.uniform1f(loc.pivot,pivot);gl.uniform1f(loc.recoil,recoil);

  gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,part.count);
 }
 function render(dt){
  const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect(),dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
  const cw=Math.max(1,Math.round(r.width*dpr)),ch=Math.max(1,Math.round(r.height*dpr));
  if(canvas.width!==cw||canvas.height!==ch){canvas.width=cw;canvas.height=ch;}
  gl.viewport(0,0,cw,ch);gl.clearColor(0,0,0,0);gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT|gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);gl.depthFunc(gl.LEQUAL);gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  gl.useProgram(program);gl.uniform1i(loc.tex,0);gl.enableVertexAttribArray(loc.pos);gl.enableVertexAttribArray(loc.col);
  gl.uniform2f(loc.viewport,r.width||1,r.height||1);gl.uniform1f(loc.mat,showMaterials?1:0);
  visualClock+=dt;
   // 3D scenery is drawn in the same projected scene as towers (not a 2D decal).
   if(sceneryMode==='glb'&&showApprovedGLB){
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,whiteTex);
    for(const it of sceneProps(level)){
     const type=it.type==='pine'?'pine'+Math.floor(sceneryHash(it.x,it.y,87)*3):it.type==='oak'?'oak':it.type==='rock'?'rock'+Math.floor(sceneryHash(it.x,it.y,91)*3):'barrier'+Math.floor(sceneryHash(it.x,it.y,93)*2);
     const parts=environmentModels[type];if(!parts)continue;
     const x=it.x,y=it.y;
     gl.uniform2f(loc.origin,view.ox+(x+.5)*CELL*view.scale,view.oy+(y+.5)*CELL*view.scale+3*view.scale);
     gl.uniform1f(loc.unit,11.4*it.size*view.scale);
     for(const part of parts)if(part&&!Array.isArray(part))drawPart(part,0,0,0,0,0,0,true);
    }
   }
   let drawn=0;
   for(const [id,t] of towers){
   if(!showApprovedGLB)break;
   if(t.progress>0)continue;
   const [x,y]=xy(id),parts=models[t.type];if(!parts)continue;drawn++;gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,paintedTextures[t.type]||whiteTex);
   let target=t.aimTarget;
   const maxRange=towerStats(t,t.level).range/CELL;
   const freshShot=(t.aimShotAt||0)>(t.lastVisualShotAt||0);
   if(freshShot&&t.aimPoint)target=t.aimPoint;
   if(!target||(!freshShot&&(target.hp<=0||!mobs.includes(target)))||Math.hypot(target.x-x,target.y-y)>maxRange){
    target=null;
    let best=Infinity;
    for(const m of mobs){
     if(m.hp<=0||(t.type==='aa'?m.kind!=='drone':m.kind==='drone'))continue;
     const d=Math.hypot(m.x-x,m.y-y);
     if(d<best&&d<=maxRange&&(t.type!=='gun'||d>=defs.gun.minRange/CELL)){best=d;target=m;}
    }
   }
   let desired=headings.get(id)??0;
   if(target&&['mg','gun','aa','flame','frost'].includes(t.type)){
    const dx=target.x-x,dy=target.y-y;
    // GLB barrels are modeled along local +X, not local +Y.
    // Screen isometric projection: sx=.70*(X-Z), sy=.33*(X+Z).
    // Invert the projection and rotate local +X to the actual shot vector.
    const worldX=(dx/.70+dy/.33)*.5;
    const worldZ=(dy/.33-dx/.70)*.5;
    desired=Math.atan2(-worldZ,worldX);
   } else if(t.type==='radar')desired=visualClock*.75;
   const prev=headings.get(id)??desired;
   const delta=(desired-prev+Math.PI*3)%(Math.PI*2)-Math.PI;
   const heading=freshShot?desired:prev+Math.max(-12*dt,Math.min(12*dt,delta));
   if(freshShot)t.lastVisualShotAt=t.aimShotAt;
   headings.set(id,heading);
   // v10.7.3: muzzle coordinates follow the SAME actual 3D turret heading.
   // Shader isometric projection: screenX=.70*(worldX-worldZ),
   // screenY=.33*(worldX+worldZ)-worldY.
   // Weapon GLBs point along local +X; heading rotates X towards -Z.
   // Keep the anchor in WORLD canvas pixels; screen viewport is applied by overlay.
   if(t.type==='mg'||t.type==='gun'){
    const cs=Math.cos(heading),sn=Math.sin(heading);
    const muzzleLength=t.type==='gun'?4.15:3.75;
    const barrelHeight=t.type==='gun'?2.35:2.05;
    const unit=17.1;
    const dx=unit*.70*muzzleLength*(cs+sn);
    const dy=unit*(.33*muzzleLength*(cs-sn)-barrelHeight);
    t.visualMuzzle={x:(x+.5)*CELL+dx,y:(y+.5)*CELL+3+dy,angle:Math.atan2(.33*(cs-sn),.70*(cs+sn))};
   }
   gl.uniform2f(loc.origin,view.ox+(x+.5)*CELL*view.scale,view.oy+(y+.5)*CELL*view.scale+3*view.scale);
   gl.uniform1f(loc.unit,17.1*view.scale);
   drawPart(parts[0],0);
   drawPart(parts[1],heading);
   // Weapon-only mesh: independently elevates around its trunnion, with event-driven recoil.
   const weaponPivot=t.type==='gun'?1.15:t.type==='aa'?1.30:t.type==='mg'?1.12:1.20;
   const pitch=(target && t.type==='gun')?.15:(target&&t.type==='aa')?.32:0;
   const shotAge=(performance.now()-(t.aimShotAt||0))/1000;
   const recoil=(shotAge>=0&&shotAge<.23 && ['mg','gun'].includes(t.type))? Math.sin(Math.PI*shotAge/.23)*(t.type==='gun'?.19:.065):0;
   drawPart(parts[2],heading,pitch,weaponPivot,recoil);
   // Moving GLB nodes, event-driven for fire/EMP/mines. No damage or reload changes.
   const mechanicAge=(performance.now()-(t.mechanicAt||0))/1000;
   const fireActive=shotAge>=0&&shotAge<.40;
   const pulseActive=mechanicAge>=0&&mechanicAge<.85;
   const cycle=visualClock;
   let motion=0,mode=0;
   switch(t.type){
    case 'mg': mode=3;motion=fireActive ? .045*Math.sin(Math.PI*Math.min(1,shotAge/.40)) : 0;break;
    case 'gun': mode=3;motion=fireActive ? .13*Math.sin(Math.PI*Math.min(1,shotAge/.32)):0;break;
    case 'aa': mode=2;motion=fireActive?.28*Math.sin(Math.PI*Math.min(1,shotAge/.40)):0;break;
    case 'flame': mode=5;motion=fireActive?.12*Math.sin(cycle*35):0;break;
    case 'frost': mode=4;motion=target?cycle*1.5:0;break;
    case 'eng': mode=2;motion=.13*Math.sin(cycle*1.8);break;
    case 'mine': mode=2;motion=pulseActive?.30*Math.sin(Math.PI*mechanicAge/.85):0;break;
    case 'emp': mode=5;motion=pulseActive?.19*Math.sin(Math.PI*mechanicAge/.85):0;break;

   }
   for(const mechanicalPart of parts[3]||[]){
    drawPart(mechanicalPart,heading,0,0,0,motion,mode);
   }
   // Display only completed visual stages. Each additional step is cumulative;
   // weapon-mounted parts share the current target angle, elevation and recoil.
   const stages=visualUpgrades[t.type]||[];
   for(let i=0;i<Math.min(5,Math.max(0,t.level-1));i++){
    const upgrade=stages[i];
    drawPart(upgrade[0],0);
    drawPart(upgrade[1],heading);
    drawPart(upgrade[2],heading,pitch,weaponPivot,recoil);
   }

  }
  debugLast+=dt;debugFrames++;debugDrawn=drawn;
  if(debugLast>=.5){
   const fps=Math.round(debugFrames/debugLast);
   const modelCount=Object.keys(models).length;
   const on=showApprovedGLB;
   const status=on?'GLB включён':'GLB выключен — резервная графика';
   const msg='Рубеж v8.6 · локальные шарниры\n'+status+
     '\nЗагружено: '+modelCount+'/9'+
     '\nБашен построено: '+towers.size+
     '\nGLB показано: '+debugDrawn+
     '\nПодвижные узлы: 4 группы (база / башня / оружие / механизм)'+'\nВизуальные стадии: 1–6 (дополнительная геометрия)'+
     '\nКадров/сек (прибл.): '+fps+
     '\nТреугольников (каталог): '+Math.round(totalTriangles).toLocaleString('ru-RU');
   el('glbDiagnostics').textContent=msg;
   el('glbReport').textContent=msg+ '\n'+(on&&debugDrawn===0?'Для проверки построй хотя бы одну башню.':'');
   window.__rubezhGLBDiagnostic=msg;
   debugLast=0;debugFrames=0;
  }
 }
 indicator.textContent='v10.0 · внешние GLB окружения · 6 уровней';
 return {ready:true,render,setDetail(v){showDetail=!!v;},setMaterials(v){showMaterials=!!v;}};
})();

el('glbMapDiagToggle').onclick=()=>{
 const panel=el('glbDiagnostics');
 panel.hidden=!panel.hidden;
 const b=el('glbMapDiagToggle');
 b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(!panel.hidden));
 b.textContent=panel.hidden?'Показать диагностику на карте':'Скрыть диагностику с карты';
};
el('glbCopy').onclick=async()=>{
 const report=window.__rubezhGLBDiagnostic||el('glbReport').textContent;
 try{
  if(navigator.clipboard&&window.isSecureContext){await navigator.clipboard.writeText(report);el('glbCopyResult').textContent='Отчёт скопирован — вставь его в чат.';}
  else{const area=document.createElement('textarea');area.value=report;area.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:-9999px;top:0';document.body.appendChild(area);area.select();const ok=document.execCommand('copy');area.remove();el('glbCopyResult').textContent=ok?'Отчёт скопирован — вставь его в чат.':'Копирование недоступно. Выдели текст отчёта и скопируй вручную.';}
 }catch(e){el('glbCopyResult').textContent='Не получилось скопировать — выдели текст отчёта вручную.';}
};

};

window.__rubezh={callHero,get selectedHero(){return selectedHero},selectHero(id){if(HEROES[id]&&wave===0){chooseHero(id);}},get heroCosts(){return {...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(HEROES).map(([k,v])=>[k,v.cost]))}},get heroCooldown(){return heroCooldown},hqLevel,buyHQUpgrade,get towerUpgrades(){return {...towerUpgrades}},restartLevel,setSpeed,get hover(){return hoverCell},get upgradePreview(){return upgradePreview},rangePreview,get state(){return {adUses,bonusPending,bonusClaimed:[...bonusClaimed],intermissionWave,intermissionLeft,level,wave,credits,kills,earnedCredits,headquarters,mobs:mobs.length,slugFlights:slugFlights.length,towers:towers.size,pending,gameSpeed,slugs,reserve,runCharged,rescueUsed}},map,pathfind,setup,buy,sell,upgrade,canBuild,get blocked(){return [...occupiedCells()]} ,get start(){return map.start},get secondStart(){return map.secondStart},get goal(){return map.goal},get pads(){return [...map.pads]},get towers(){return [...towers.values()].map(t=>({...t,cells:[...t.cells]}))},get slugs(){return slugs},get activePerks(){return [...activePerks]},togglePerk,claimLevelReward,openHQ,spendReserve,rescue,get mobs(){return mobs.map(m=>({...m}))},get emp(){return [...towers.values()].filter(t=>t.type==='emp').map(t=>({id:t.id,level:t.level,timer:t.timer}))},get waveQueue(){return [...spawnQueue]},grantReserveAd,offerWaveBonus,closeBonus,updateIntermission,updateSlugFlights,waveComposition,waveTypes,ENEMY_TYPES,spawn,engineerNeighbors,repairTargets, get selected(){return selectedCell},tick(dt){update(dt)}};
